lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are visible; the medial row contains four prominent, nearly equidistant maxima aligned posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary spot centroids, creating a structural grid-like appearance on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high density of small, irregularly shaped high-luminance clusters that are significantly smaller and more densely packed than the primary flank blobs.
